title: Upstream source-instance inventory
description: Durable upstream evidence from explicitly pinned project snapshots. Resolved candidate identity is only (project, sourceId).

upstreams.description: Pinned upstream inputs. Project uniqueness is enforced by deterministic validation.

unresolvedModules.description: Module-level discovery failures for which stable source instances could not be resolved without guessing.

commit.description: Pinned immutable Git commit hash for this upstream project.

candidate.description: One resolved upstream source instance. Stable identity is (project, sourceId); module may change without changing identity.

sourceId.description: Opaque upstream continuity identity serialized as a JSON string.

module.description: Required current upstream locator and provenance; excluded from candidate identity.

upstreamLang.description: Raw upstream language evidence. Values such as 'all' remain unnormalized.

canonicalLocale.description: Optional derived VeneraX-facing locale. Omission means unresolved; no value is inferred from upstreamLang.

baseUrl.description: Optional upstream site evidence, not an identity or registry join key.

contentWarning.description: Optional evidence-backed warning; omission means unknown.

theme.description: Optional raw upstream theme or family evidence.

unresolvedModule.description: A current module locator whose source instances could not be resolved to stable IDs.

compatibility.description: Orthogonal observations for an identified candidate; import readiness is derived rather than independently persisted.

patchRequired.description: Optional classified patch observation. Omission means unknown or not yet classified.
